scope: Software integration and layout checks on cached notebook values; no re-evaluation of raw predictions or validation of scientific protocols.
checks: All packaged Python files parse with Python 3.8 syntax rules.
Energy adapters preserve point-weighted source values and distinguish 3 Move-IIT algorithms / 5 operating points; missing intervals remain missing.
Accuracy-rate renderer runs on actual cached DHP19 and native-time Move-IIT summaries, including multiple flow styles and explicit ticks.
Energy–RTF renderer runs on cached Move-IIT numerical values with the actual available confidence bounds.
All three datasets use the fixed color/marker registry; rendering isolates a pre-existing dark notebook style and retains 178 mm width.
Duplicate points, mixed declared protocols, PCK above 100%, and one-sided intervals are rejected.
Intervals that do not bracket the estimate render without clipping or moving the original estimate.
All notebook code cells execute in order in a fresh namespace using the shipped preview configuration.
SVG contains editable text and all five legend labels; exported provenance is strict JSON without NaN literals.
PDF inspected at 178 x 173 mm; STIXGeneral font is embedded. Final annotations and logarithmic interval extents inspected visually.
